==History== The Government of West Bengal unbundled the erstwhile West Bengal State Electricity Board (WBSEB) into two companies: West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL) and West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (WBSETCL). The main business of WBSEDCL is distribution and [[Hydroelectricity|hydro generation]] of electricity. It is also the nodal agency of the Government of West Bengal for undertaking the [[Rural Electrification]] task in the State with the objective of providing access to electricity to all rural households in the state in line with the ''National Rural Electrification Policy''. After the successful implementation of the [[Purulia Pumped Storage Project]] in the 10th Plan period with a capacity of 900 MW hydel power, the company has taken up the ambitious plan of implementing the Turga Pumped Storage Project in the 13th Plan period with an installed capacity of 4 x 250 MW.{{cite web|url=https://www.wberc.gov.in/oldwebsite/wberc/tariff/wbseb/Tariff/ordnpet2001/wbseb_or_05_06_1.htm|title=Tariff Order of West Bengal State Electricity Board (2005–06)|website=West Bengal Electricity Regulatory Commission|access-date=2026-05-12}}{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/west-bengal/an-electric-film-on-a-golden-history/cid/1277528|title=An electric film on a golden history|website=The Telegraph India|access-date=2026-05-12}} == Recruitment == WBSEDCL recruits its officers and employees through various competitive examinations, including the [[Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering]] (GATE) and other recruitment examinations conducted by the corporation. Class I or Group A officers of the technical cadre are primarily recruited through the GATE examination, while officers of the finance cadre are appointed through separate examinations conducted by WBSEDCL.{{cite web|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/pdf/Careers/AE%28Civil%29_AE%28Elect%29_12.09.2019.pdf|title=Recruitment of Assistant Engineer (Civil & Electrical) (12.09.2019)|website=WBSEDCL|access-date=2026-05-12}}{{cite web|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/pdf/Careers/Website%20Notification%20w.r.t%20Notification%20No.%20MPP-2025-04%20Dt.%2024.11.2025_27_11.pdf|title=Website Notification w.r.t. Notification No. MPP-2025-04 (24.11.2025)|website=WBSEDCL|access-date=2026-05-12}}{{cite web|url=https://blog.madeeasy.in/wbsedcl-careers|title=All You Need to Know About WBSEDCL Careers|website=MADE EASY Blog|access-date=2026-05-12}} == Training == After qualifying through the [[Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering]] (GATE), candidates join the services of WBSEDCL at the post of Assistant Engineer (AE). Induction training is conducted at Vidyut Bhavan in [[Bidhannagar]], Kolkata, in their respective disciplines. From the first day of appointment, officers are entitled to receive full salary and associated benefits. Following the completion of induction training, Assistant Engineers are posted at various customer care centres and divisional offices across the state. The probation period for Assistant Engineers is two years.{{cite web|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/pdf/Careers/JOINING_SCHEDULE_AE(E)_MPP_2019_03.pdf|title=Joining Schedule for Assistant Engineer (Electrical) under MPP-2019-03|website=WBSEDCL|access-date=2026-05-12}} ==Organizational Structure== === Board of Directors === The company is managed by a board of directors comprising fourteen members, out of which seven are executive directors (coming from the WBSEDCL Group A engineers, [[West Bengal Civil Service|WBCS]] officers and other dignitaries), including chairman and managing director who is an [[Indian Administrative Service|IAS]] officer.{{cite web|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/boardOfDirectors.html|title=Board of Directors|website=WBSEDCL|access-date=2026-05-12}} Besides one woman director and six independent directors constitute the board includes: {| class="wikitable sortable" |+ Board of Directors ! After approximately 8 years of service, they become eligible for promotion to Divisional Engineer (DE). Following around 15 years of service, officers are typically promoted to the position of Regional Manager. After about 21 years of service, they advance to the post of Zonal Manager. Subsequently, after nearly 27 years of service, officers are promoted to the rank of Chief Engineer, which is generally the terminal rank for most engineering personnel.{{cite web|url=https://power.wb.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/Director.pdf|title=Director – WBSEDCL (Official Document)|website=Department of Power, Government of West Bengal|access-date=2026-05-12}} Only a limited number of officers are later empanelled for higher positions such as Director, based on merit, experience, and organizational requirements. However, the position of Managing Director is typically held by a non-technical officer, usually from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS).{{cite news|url=https://www.millenniumpost.in/kolkata/santanu-basu-takes-charge-as-wbsedcl-cmd-359742|title=Santanu Basu takes charge as WBSEDCL CMD|website=Millennium Post|date=24 June 2019|access-date=2026-05-12}} {| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible" |+Ranks, designations, and positions held by Group A / Class 1 officers in their career in the WBSEDCL |- ! This ultimately create a salary more than a Group A [[West Bengal Civil Service|WBCS]] officer.{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/west-bengal/da-order-for-power-utility/cid/1753613|title=DA order for power utility|website=The Telegraph India|access-date=2026-05-12}} Employees are also eligible for leave benefits as per the Government leave policy. Newly appointed Group A officers are provided with official residential accommodation (on availability, such as 2 BHK for AE, 3 BHK for DE, 4 BHK for RM and above) and an official vehicle from the first day of service. Vehicles allotted for official duties may include models such as the [[Mahindra Bolero]] (for AE & AM), [[Mahindra Scorpio]] (for DE & DM), and [[Toyota Fortuner]] (for SE & RM and above). === Offices === The organization is divided into key functional areas covering Distribution, Projects, Generation, Finance, and Human Resources. Likewise, SAP in financial accounting and control, material management, HR with payroll, plant maintenance and project system. Apart from that SCADA, smart grid, development of IT system through R-APDRP Project, mobile app development, e-payment through website and third party, spot bill, WhatsApp chatbot, collection kiosk etc., have been implemented.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=IT|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/Information_Technology.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}} After successful implementation of '''[[Purulia Pumped Storage Power Station|Purulia Pumped Storage Project]]''' in 10th Plan period with a capacity of 900 MW hydel power, the company has taken up the ambitious plan of implementing Turga Pumped Storage Project in the 13th Plan period with installed capacity of 4 x 250 MW.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=PUMP STORAGE|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/Pumped_Storage.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}} A project titled Integrated Power Development Scheme ([https://www.ipds.gov.in/ IPDS]) for strengthening of sub-transmission and distribution networks, metering of distribution transformers, reduction of AT&C loss, access to power to all households, etc., in the urban areas having population of more than 50,000 as per 2011 census has been undertaken. Many new sub-stations have been constructed under this centrally funded scheme across the state of West Bengal.{{cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=IPDS|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/IPDS.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|work=WBSEDCL}} Another project titled Deendayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana ([http://www.ddugjy.gov.in/ DDUGJY]) for separation of agricultural and non-agricultural feeders, strengthening of sub-transmission and distribution networks, metering of distribution transformers, reduction of AT&C loss, access to power to all houseland, etc., in the rural areas has been undertaken. Many new sub-stations have been constructed under this centrally funded scheme across the state of West Bengal.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=DDUGJY|url=https://www.wbsedcl.in/irj/go/km/docs/internet/new_website/DDUGJY.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}} A new project to be funded by the World Bank is also in the pipeline. A programme for system improvement under Sech Bandhu Scheme has also been conceived for rural areas. ==See also== * [[West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company|West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company Limited]] * [[West Bengal Power Development Corporation]] * [[CESC Limited]] * [[West Bengal Civil Service]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Power Plants of West Bengal}} {{authority control}} [[Category:State agencies of West Bengal]] [[Category:Electric power transmission system operators in India]] [[Category:Energy in West Bengal]] [[Category:State electricity agencies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:2007 establishments in West Bengal]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2000]] [[Category:Electric power companies of India]]

West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (WBSEDCL) is a wholly owned enterprise of Government of West Bengal, established in 2007 as one of the two successors of West Bengal State Electricity Board (WBSEB), and is responsible for providing power to 96% of West Bengal with a customer base of more than 2.2 crore across the state.
It states its vision "to be the best power utility in India in terms of customer service, efficient, and financial viability" while its mission to "supply uninterrupted and quality power to all."
It is expanding the range and quantity of uninterrupted electric supply in the remote villages in rapid speed.
